edo100.en: One Hundred Famous Views of Edo

kisokaido.ja: 木曾海道六拾九次之内

entries.why: Risshun: spring begins while snow still lies on Mount Hira above the lake. Buckingham impression (1925.3404, 3000×1971 px).
The bush warblers' kō; the famous reclining plum of Kameido in full bloom. Henderson gift impression (1965.1027, 6482×9240 px); alternates: 26577 (1925.3752), 34046 (1939.1405).
Rain softens the soil; the plum orchard at Kamata under a soft February sky. Gookin impression (1939.1461, 2571×3655 px); alternates: 150276 (1965.1025).
Cranes rise from the marsh at dawn as the grasses bud; the last kō of Usui. Buckingham impression (1925.3234, 3000×2071 px).
Insects wake and the water runs again; the millwheel at Onden turns in early March. Buckingham impression (1925.3233, 8847×6083 px).

title.en: Dawn at Isawa in Kai Province

entries.why: Travellers set out at first light in the soft air of early spring. Buckingham impression (1925.3235, 3000×2055 px).
Warm enough to work outdoors; the cooper frames Fuji in his half-made tub. Buckingham impression (1925.3229, 3000×2062 px).

title.en: Sekiya Village on the Sumida River

entries.why: Spring equinox; riders race the dawn along the Sumida embankment. Buckingham impression (1925.3268, 3000×2048 px).

title.en: Kiyomizu Hall and Shinobazu Pond at Ueno

entries.why: The first cherry blossoms open: Ueno was where Edo saw them first. Buckingham impression (1938.538, 2538×3576 px); alternates: 150263 (1965.1012).

title.ja: 東海道品川御殿山ノ不二
title.en: Goten Hill at Shinagawa on the Tokaido

entries.why: Seimei, cherry at its height: blossom-viewing parties on Goten Hill with Fuji beyond. Buckingham impression (1925.3274, 3000×2093 px).

title.en: View to the North from Asuka Hill

entries.why: Wild geese fly north; picnics under the cherries of Asuka Hill, looking north to Tsukuba. Buckingham impression (1925.3745, 2388×3618 px); alternates: 196758 (1990.607.79), 34016 (1939.1398).
The first rainbow of the year: the only rainbow in the hundred views. Buckingham impression (1927.319, 2430×3654 px); alternates: 196797 (1990.607.118).

title.en: Suijin Shrine and Massaki on the Sumida River

entries.why: Kokuu, the grain rains: late cherry framing the river at Suijin's grove. Gookin impression (1939.1408, 2172×3312 px); alternates: 34061 (1939.1409), 26581 (1925.3753).
The frost ends; spring low tides and clam-gathering under the torii at Noboto. Buckingham impression (1925.3232, 8794×6071 px).

title.en: The Tea Plantation of Katakura in Suruga Province

entries.why: The eighty-eighth night: tea picking on the Katakura slopes at the turn of May. Buckingham impression (1925.3231, 3000×2084 px).
Rikka and the fifth-day festival: carp streamers over Suidōbashi. Gookin impression (1939.1467, 2507×3663 px).
Wisteria over the drum bridge at Kameido, mid-May. Henderson gift impression (1965.1052, 2043×3000 px); alternates: 34103 (1939.1423), 26607 (1925.3762).
Silkworms wake in Kai, the silk province; pack horses climb Inume Pass. Buckingham impression (1925.3283, 3000×2062 px).

title.en: Fuji from Kanaya on the Tokaido

entries.why: Early-summer river crossings: porters ford the Ōi at Kanaya. Buckingham impression (1937.193, 3000×2079 px).
The wheat ripens: farmers and travellers on the plank bridge through the fields. Buckingham impression (1925.3230, 3000×2042 px).
Firefly season on swollen rivers; the fisherman on the rocks at Kajikazawa. Buckingham impression (1934.261, 3000×2074 px); alternates: 87003 (1925.3242).
Summer solstice: a thunderstorm below while the summit stands in sun. Buckingham impression (1952.342, 9933×6680 px); alternates: 87008 (1925.3244).
The irises' own kō: the hanashōbu gardens at Horikiri. Buckingham impression (1925.3763, 2433×3618 px); alternates: 34100 (1939.1422), 88441 (1938.535), 34097 (1939.1421), 150302 (1965.1051).
The last days of the rains: travellers shelter from a downpour at Suhara. Buckingham impression (1925.3719, 3000×1992 px).
Shōsho begins on Tanabata; bamboo and paper streamers over the roofs of Edo. Gookin impression (1939.1424, 2460×3576 px); alternates: 196796 (1990.607.117).

title.en: The Surface of the Water at Misaka in Koshu Province

entries.why: High summer: the bare mountain and its snow-capped reflection in Lake Kawaguchi. Buckingham impression (1925.3275, 3000×2048 px).
Summer pilgrimage across the sands to Enoshima at low tide. Buckingham impression (1925.3271, 3000×2300 px).
The paulownias set seed: the grove at Akasaka above the reservoir. Gookin impression (1939.1415, 2472×3654 px); alternates: 150294 (1965.1043).

title.ja: 御厩川岸より両国橋夕陽見
title.reading: Onmayagashi yori Ryōgokubashi sekiyō o miru
title.en: Viewing Sunset over the Ryogoku Bridge from the Onmaya Embankment

entries.why: Damp heat: the evening cool on the river, sunset behind Ryōgoku Bridge. Warner gift impression (1932.166, 3000×2058 px); alternates: 24696 (1925.3260).

title.en: Sudden Shower over Shin Ohashi Bridge and Atake

entries.why: Great rains fall from time to time: the evening downpour on Shin-Ōhashi. Warner gift impression (1932.214, 2220×3456 px); alternates: 64447 (1981.1206), 26545 (1925.3742).

title.en: Under the Wave off Kanagawa (The Great Wave)

entries.why: Risshū: the first cool wind comes off the sea. Buckingham impression (1925.3245, 6679×4577 px); alternates: 77333 (1952.343), 89503 (1928.1086).

title.en: A Mild Breeze on a Fine Day

entries.why: The south wind clears the dawn sky and the mountain turns red, late summer. Buckingham impression (1952.341, 9649×6514 px); alternates: 87005 (1925.3243), 89500 (1928.1085).
Thick fog wraps the hills: the giant cedar on the pass, Fuji half hidden. Buckingham impression (1925.3281, 3000×2047 px).
The first autumn gust: hats and papers scatter across the marsh road at Ejiri. Buckingham impression (1925.3285, 8882×6046 px); alternates: 13272 (1961.171).
Heaven and earth begin to cool: dusk under the pines at Mochizuki, the full-moon station. Henderson gift impression (1963.701, 3672×2430 px); alternates: 13213 (1961.154), 26492 (1925.3724).

title.en: Rice Paddies at Ono in Suruga Province

entries.why: The rice ripens: reed-carriers through the new paddies at Ōno. Buckingham impression (1925.3286, 3000×2064 px).

title.ja: 東海道江尻田子の浦略図
title.en: Tagonoura Bay near Ejiri on the Tokaido

entries.why: White dew: a clear early-autumn morning over Tago Bay. Buckingham impression (1925.3279, 3000×2059 px); alternates: 130734 (1964.1058b).
Wagtails on the sluice gates; a farmer and his horse pause at Senju. Buckingham impression (1925.3276, 3000×2049 px); alternates: 13274 (1961.172).

title.en: The Moon Pine on the Temple Grounds at Ueno

entries.why: Autumn equinox: the Moon Pine at Ueno looks over Shinobazu Pond. Gookin impression (1939.1490, 2400×3576 px).
Insects seal their doors; travellers under the pines of Hodogaya in the autumn haze. Buckingham impression (1925.3239, 3562×2412 px).
The paddies are drained; clear October light along Shichirigahama. Buckingham impression (1925.3236, 3000×2064 px).
Wild geese return: the descending geese of Katada, one of the eight classic views. Warner gift impression (1932.209, 3000×2041 px); alternates: 25228 (1925.3402), 25232 (1925.3403), 47768 (1974.454).

title.ja: 五百らかん寺さざゐどう
title.en: Sazai Hall at the Temple of the Five Hundred Arhats

entries.why: Chrysanthemum season skies: the Sazai Hall balcony faces a clear Fuji. Buckingham impression (1925.3263, 8786×6088 px).

title.en: In the Mountains of Totomi Province

entries.why: Crickets at the door; sawyers at work in the Tōtōmi hills, smoke rising in the cool. Buckingham impression (1925.3278, 3000×2053 px); alternates: 149105 (1997.736).
Light rain comes and goes: a procession under umbrellas at Tarui. Wright gift impression (1961.155, 3000×1902 px).

title.ja: 真間の紅葉手古那の社継はし
title.reading: Mama no momiji Tekona no yashiro Tsugihashi
title.en: Maple Trees at Mama, Tekona Shrine and Tsugi Bridge

entries.why: Maples and ivy turn: the red maples of Mama frame Tekona's shrine. Gookin impression (1939.1433, 2592×3738 px); alternates: 26525 (1925.3735).

title.ja: 関口上水端はせを庵椿やま
title.en: Basho's Hut on Camellia Hill Beside the Aqueduct at Sekiguchi

entries.why: The first camellias open on Camellia Hill above the aqueduct at Sekiguchi. Gookin impression (1939.1413, 2526×3666 px); alternates: 196850 (1990.607.171), 34066 (1939.1411).

title.en: Precincts of the Akiba Shrine, Ukeji

entries.why: The ground begins to freeze; late maples reflected in the Akiba shrine pond. Wright gift impression (1961.146, 2592×3696 px); alternates: 34128 (1939.1431), 34123 (1939.1430), 26547 (1925.3743).

title.en: Asakusa Rice Fields and Torinomachi Festival

entries.why: The Tori-no-ichi fair of November: a cat watches the procession cross the rice fields. Gookin impression (1939.1439, 2256×3366 px); alternates: 13192 (1961.147), 26534 (1925.3738).

title.ja: 従千住花街眺望ノ不二
title.reading: Senju kagai yori chōbō no Fuji
title.en: Mount Fuji Seen from the Senju Pleasure Quarter

entries.why: Rainbows hide away; a procession passes the stubble fields under a clear late-autumn Fuji. Buckingham impression (1925.3280, 3000×2087 px).
Early-winter clarity: Fuji framed under Mannen Bridge. Buckingham impression (1925.3272, 3000×2066 px).
Bears settle into their dens; travellers bent under the snow at Ōi. Buckingham impression (1928.349, 3570×2274 px).
The eagle over the frozen marsh at Jūmantsubo, deep December. Warner gift impression (1932.213, 2352×3510 px); alternates: 26605 (1925.3761).
Winter solstice: a snowy morning seen from the teahouse at Koishikawa. Wright gift impression (1961.170, 3000×1990 px); alternates: 24704 (1925.3262).
The year's end under snow at the timber yards of Fukagawa. Gookin impression (1939.1443, 2592×3708 px); alternates: 34172 (1939.1444).

title.en: Clear Weather After Snow at Nihon Bridge

entries.why: New Year: the first print of the hundred views, Nihonbashi clearing after snow. Gookin impression (1939.1451, 2526×3714 px); alternates: 13199 (1961.149), 150256 (1965.1004), 34190 (1939.1450).
Shōkan and the New Year holidays: kites over the slope at Kasumigaseki. Henderson gift impression (1965.1005, 2007×3000 px); alternates: 196726 (1990.607.47), 34197 (1939.1452).
Pheasants begin to call: herons startle from the frozen reeds at Ushibori. Buckingham impression (1925.3238, 3000×2028 px).
Daikan: cranes come down to the winter paddies at Mikawashima. Buckingham impression (1925.3751, 2364×3546 px); alternates: 196759 (1990.607.80), 34159 (1939.1440).
Ice thickens on the streams: Lake Suwa, famous for freezing over in late January. Buckingham impression (1925.3284, 8852×6007 px).

title.en: Drum Bridge and Yuhi Hill at Meguro

entries.why: The last kō of winter: the drum bridge at Meguro under falling snow. Henderson gift impression (1962.1098, 2466×3654 px); alternates: 26615 (1925.3764).

title.en: View of Tsukuda Island from Eitai Bridge

entries.why: February nights: whitebait boats under a late-winter moon off Tsukuda Island. Buckingham impression (1925.3732, 1979×3000 px); alternates: 196742 (1990.607.63).

title.en: Night View of Matsuchi Hill and the San'ya Canal

entries.why: March nights: a starry spring night over the San'ya canal. Henderson gift impression (1965.1031, 2424×3582 px); alternates: 33999 (1939.1393), 60210 (1928.302).
April nights: a full moon over the Wada River, children still out playing. Warner gift impression (1932.173, 3588×2352 px); alternates: 26479 (1925.3720).
May nights: a family crosses the bridge by moonlight through early-summer mist. Warner gift impression (1932.211, 3684×2436 px); alternates: 26489 (1925.3723).
June nights: the rainy season, night rain on the great pine of Karasaki. Buckingham impression (1952.335, 3000×2005 px); alternates: 25254 (1925.3410).
July nights: the river opening and its fireworks over Ryōgoku Bridge. Gookin impression (1939.1437, 2036×3000 px); alternates: 25601 (1966.316), 13195 (1961.148).
August nights: pilgrims' lanterns cross Kyōbashi under a high-summer moon. Gookin impression (1939.1425, 2418×3612 px); alternates: 13198 (1961.149A).
September nights: the harvest moon over Lake Biwa from Ishiyama Temple. Buckingham impression (1925.3405, 3000×1973 px).
October nights: the later moon-viewing, the thirteenth night, from a room above the bay. Gookin impression (1939.1485, 2346×3480 px); alternates: 196795 (1990.607.116).

November nights: the theatre street under a late-autumn moon as the kaomise season opens. Gookin impression (1939.1429, 2316×3510 px); alternates: 150330 (1965.1080), 26629 (1925.3769), 34117 (1939.1428).

title.ja: 王子装束ゑの木大晦日の狐火
title.reading: Ōji shōzoku enoki ōmisoka no kitsunebi
title.en: Fox Fires on New Year's Eve at the Changing Tree in Oji

entries.why: December nights: the foxes gather under the enoki tree on the last night of the year. Gookin impression (1939.1449, 2448×3582 px); alternates: 13183 (1961.144), 26617 (1925.3765).
